Name: POSTURE_CONTROL_PARAM_WEP_RIGHT_ST
Description: Weapon posture twist for the weapon in the right hand, or for the weapon being two-handed (either hand). Row ID = posture type × 100 + the weapon's Posture Control ID (Right); posture type is 0 normally, 1 while riding Torrent and 2 while in stealth (crouching). Each aNNN group is picked by the active weapon motion category: the right-hand weapon's one-handed motion ID when one-handing, or the two-handed weapon's two-handed motion ID; categories without a group (1, 4–9, 11) get no twist, and a missing row gives 0. Values are the maximum twist: the behaviour script scales them by a weight set by the current animation's TimeAct events and eases toward the result (up to 90 per second).

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Arm - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Right arm forward/back twist. Combined with the chest armour's value (PostureControlParam_Pro): the one with the larger magnitude is used. When one-handing, using paired weapons or riding it moves the right arm forward/back; when two-handing it raises/lowers both arms. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Wrist - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Right wrist forward/back bend. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Wrist - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Right wrist inside/outside twist. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Weapon Rotation
Fields.Description: Twist of the right-hand weapon. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Arm - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Left arm forward/back twist, only while this weapon is two-handed (otherwise the left weapon's PostureControlParam_WepLeft value is used). Combined with the chest armour's value: the one with the larger magnitude is used. The behaviour script applies left-arm forward/back only when using paired weapons or riding, so it has no effect in a normal two-handed stance. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.
